preconditions.description: The number of flowers n must be between 1 and 100.
The number of subarrays m must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(-100 <= a_i <= 100 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each flower's mood must be between -100 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l_i <= r_i <= n for l_i, r_i in subarrays)
preconditions.description: Each subarray must be within the bounds of the flower array.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum possible value added to Alyona's happiness.
